review_description: Great price, friendly sales, super quick turnaround to install system

From the moment I started talking with Peter I knew I was in safe hands. I was provided with patient advice which made me feel comfortable with proceeding. The installation was done in a very professional manner. I had no idea there was so much involved. All in all I'm very happy.
Good service, neatness and  happy to pass on knowledge - thankyou,Mike

sales/quoting process - great: the salesman was patient, answer all my questions, was not pushing for a saleinstallation: was delayed by couple weeks due to battery availability. On the day the installation team was tidy, punctual and they listen to all my concerns and answer all my questions.

Peter from Vista Electrical was great and answered all my questions from the very beginning (quotation stages) to the installation of the system. I'm now awaiting my energy provider to upgrade my meter before turning the solar system on.Also, thank you Solar Quotes for providing 3 reputable installers for me to choose from which I opted for Vista Electrical Controls.
Sales process was good and knowledgeable.Installation was done on a timely manner . Work was tidy and professional.Customer service was good and was running from day one
Impressed with the service from quote to install. Very well priced supplier and installer.
Everything was smooth. The sales person was knowledgeable and professional.
Great experience from start researching till making contact with the supplier. Looking forward for the new solar system!
Great sales service. All the documentation preparation. Great installation and offer after sales/install support. Would recommend vista , in fact I have to my builder and friends who are building

We feel we won the Jackpot. Peter, the sales person, gave us lots of choices without pushing any sales. I felt I was in control and he was guiding whenever I had a question. The installer was the owner rather than subcontractors. Installation was smooth and everything was cleaned up afterwards. Since the installation we had a thunderstorm with proper gales and downpour - no leakage and everything still in place.The system is a 10kW solar with a 10kW Sungrow battery and was $4000 cheaper than the other company serving the area with a 6.6kW solar and 10kW Sungrow system. Since installation our grid consumption has dropped by 90% despite A/C flat out, pool pump running 10 hrs per day and three fridges running like made in the heat. In hindsight, I wish I had 5kWh more battery power and I would be completely off grid.
The owner operator was known to us prior. We have high regard for his capabilities as a successful industrial electrician.Narendra is highly recommended at every stage of the process.
Polite tidy punctual easy installation good customer service helped with grid connection.

Peter was great answering all my doubts and explaining the different system. Due to distance, I can only call/email to ask about my enquiries but Peter politely answered all.No issues with installation and solar system work perfectly, which can be monitor on the app.
Easy no issue everything sorted.Neat installEverything explained well
Great value, good sales info and quick installation. Straightforward and no nonsense service.

The sales & quoting process was simple and to the point. The installation team was punctual, courteous and organised. They have clearly done this many times before. All the necessary paperwork and approvals were handled seamlessly. No problems, delays, niggles or issues. Can recommend them based on our experience.
Fantastic service, the installers were very nice and accommodating to deal with.The app is a must and we can already see our savings.

The quotation was well presented, within my budget and after sales service clearly explained.The installation was carried out on time in an orderly and tidy manner without any hassles.The customer service was good, They helped with all the regulatory compliance requirements.All I was required to do was sign the applications.
Tidy installGood feedback on reasons for install location.Recommendations on how to maximise benefits.

Sales and quoting was straightforward. The installation went as well as any trade job we have had on the property. They were happy to install to my requirement, which was to not have any panels facing the street despite this being the NW side of the house. I don't want panels visible from than angle. Works pretty well despite not being optimally configured.

The quote was prompt and competitive.Peter was very informative, helpful and explained what systems and options would suit my needs. His explanations made good sense.The installation was much quicker than I expected.The installer was prompt, polite and cleaned up after himself.He positioned the inverter perfectly and it looks great!He also spent lots of time setting the App up with me and logging in to the system and explaining the results/numbers.The whole thing was up and running the same day.Very happy customer!

After receiving a couple of quotes from installers on Solar Quotes, I also did a little leg-work myself. Not saying I was unhappy with the quotes I received, but just to make sure there weren't better options.I saw a local company on the Solar Quotes web site's "recommended installers" list and sent them an email. Vista Electrical Controls got back to me quickly, drew up a digital plan and sent it through within a day. It was a great price, but didn't have the components I was interested in. I replied to ask for a quote with the inverters and panels I wanted. Again very quickly, Narendra from Vista Electrical sent through 2 more plans and quotes with the components I was after. The price was very competitive, and my requests for panel layouts were taken into consideration.The installation was carried out soon after accepting the quote. The work was done quickly by both Narendra and his off-sider who arrived on time, and carried out the job within the estimated time frame they specified.Everything was taken care of by Vista Electrical Controls when it came to Synergy and grid connection. They submitted the documentation and arranged for my new meter to be installed.Overall,i was very impressed with their work and wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking to have solar installed.

I was pleased with the whole process.The original quotation was honest and didn’t include any yodel, in fact the opposite, advising that the most basic system was suitable for my needs.The install wa a quick and clean and they even paused when my wife had a video meeting.Would highly recommend.
Very understanding and explain very clearly to us what we should getVery good advise
I have installed solar system 6 weeks ago. Everything runs well. Vista has good customer service and good technicians.
Good value, JA panels and Solis inverter. Works well, 5kW for ~6 hr/day.

Smooth, quick and quality from sales to installation. Peter the sales consultant was very helpful and always picked up the phone to discuss options and the quote. After reviewing 3 quotes Vista had the best offering and were local. After paying the deposit I was amazed that an install slot came open with 4 days, brillant! Install team were good and explained how the setup and app worked. system got turned on that day and I have been producing ever since !
Fast and punctual,  neat installation which was on time and professional

Had several discussions with Peter of Vidta Electrical Controls about the Solar panels he offered and whether I should consider other factors. He has been very helpful in his explanations and suggestions. He was also very patient in helping with the pre-installation procedures. Highly recommend using this company.
